finding_responses.resolution: MIME is now derived from the same resolved message content inside GetMessageFile, following design §6.5: photo maps to image/jpeg; video, document, audio, animation, and voiceNote use their content MimeType fields; sticker and videoNote return empty; nil or empty MIME fields return empty without an error. The erroneous GetFileMimeType('%d.bin') call was removed. The clientAdapter and Repo growth is narrowed to DownloadFile only, and GetFile and GetFileMimeType were removed from the adapter, mocks, app repo interface, and tests.

No code change was required because the round-1 implementation already used the real go-tdlib v0.7.6 fields named in the corrected mapping table: Video.Video, Document.Document, Audio.Audio, VoiceNote.Voice, Animation.Animation, VideoNote.Video, and Sticker.Sticker. The test fixtures therefore already exercised MessageVoiceNote rather than the nonexistent MessageVoice type.

scope_summary: Implemented the two additive facade RPCs GetMessageFile and DownloadFile with the exact four proto messages from design §5. The app layer resolves the eight supported media types, selects the photo variant with the largest Photo.Size using ties-last, derives MIME from the resolved message content with zero extra RPC, performs synchronous downloads with Priority 16, applies the completed-local-copy oracle, and maps absent files and failed or incomplete downloads to the two new typed errors. The infra layer adds only the DownloadFile clientAdapter method and Repo wrapper with FloodWaitFromError handling; transport adds request validation, raw TDLib to proto mapping, and semantic error mapping. Tests cover media resolution, the middle-position largest photo, content-derived MIME and its nil or empty fallback, absent-file cases, download failures, direct download success, transport mapping, invalid IDs, and the download passthrough. N1 through N8 remain out of scope: no streaming, progress or updateFile push, upload-side behavior, GraphQL surface, engine changes, download-management RPCs, Message.file_path population or removal, or client-selectable photo variant selection.

test_notes.red_path_proof: The round-1 proof remains valid because the photo selector is unchanged. Temporarily changing the maximum-size condition to first-only would resolve TestService_GetMessageFile_MediaTypes/photo to Id 1 instead of Id 42; DownloadFile would then receive FileId 1 and fail the strict mock matcher req.FileId == fileID && req.Priority == 16 && req.Synchronous, where fileID is 42. The original selector was restored. The content-derived MIME change adds no new red path: its per-type and empty-field assertions bind mimeType directly to the same content instance used for file resolution.
